free_tier.stated: no free tier; the cheapest VPS Eco configuration in the vendor's forum post is the minimum purchasable plan of 2 vCore, 2 GB RAM, 10 GB SSD NVMe on a 25 Gbit/s port (FairUse) in Italy at EUR 2.35 with the LET15 coupon (15% off, recurring), restated by the vendor from an initial EUR 2.13; the Eco page prints no price
free_tier.notes: price and shape are the vendor's own statements on a third-party forum; the first-party Eco page is a configurator with no printed price

retention.stated: unverified: no retention, cancellation or deletion term is stated on the pages captured

egress.terms: 25 Gbit/s port (FairUse) in Italy and 10G in the Netherlands; no monthly transfer quota is stated in the vendor's post; the Fair Use Policy text is unverified

interface_detail: unverified: the access method is not described on the pages captured
tooling: unverified: no control panel or API is described on the pages captured; the Eco page lists Ubuntu, CentOS, AlmaLinux, Fedora, OpenSuse and Windows Server images
chaining: Italian or Dutch shared-core VPS from EUR 2.35 with a 25 Gbit/s port in Italy, payable by crypto, credit card, bank transfer or PayPal.

limits.value: 25 Gbit/s port (FairUse); the vendor states very small configurations may not saturate it because the CPU becomes the bottleneck

limits_note: the Eco tier has shared network and cores; the minimum purchasable plan is 2 vCore, 2 GB RAM and 10 GB disk
binding_note: the shared FairUse port is the only ceiling stated; no byte quota is stated

identity_cost.detail: the registration form at billing1.xeniahosting.com/register asks for first name, last name, email, password, password confirmation and a phone number with a country prefix, all required; Google and Discord OAuth registration are also offered, and whether either skips the phone is unverified; no card, postal address or ID document is asked at registration

reliability_note: shared network and cores on the Eco tier; the vendor states its Italian DDoS protection is in Beta (forum post); unverified: no incident or status history captured
confidence_note: the plan, its price and the payment methods are the vendor's statements in a LowEndTalk offer thread, not on the vendor site; the Eco page and the checkout page print no price to an anonymous visitor, and the vendor states the price is visible only after creating an account; the post date is not shown in the capture; the vendor restated the first plan's price from EUR 2.13 to EUR 2.35 in a reply; the billing term and the registration form are first-party
